content: Supabase Custom Access Token Hook (Auth Hooks) runs server-side before a JWT is issued and can inject custom claims (e.g. tenant_id) into app_metadata, which is safe from user tampering (unlike user_metadata). RLS policies can then read auth.jwt()->>'tenant_id' directly. This is the native Supabase-recommended way to carry tenant_id through the JWT when not using per-tenant schemas.
